name: Cherry for Your Thoughts?

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can learn that a private patron hired the raiders who struck human and dwarven camps. The Horde did not hire them.
As a Horde adventurer, you can learn from Tokal that private mercenary contracts led to the attacks on Alliance camps. They were not official Horde aggression.

faq.answer: Tokal is a mercenary hiding in Booty Bay. A marshal is investigating raids on human and dwarven settlements, and Tokal offers to tell who hired her for a Cherry Grog.
Tokal wants a Cherry Grog before discussing her past contracts. Then she will explain who privately funded the raids on Alliance camps.
faq.q: Why does Tokal want a Cherry Grog?

faq.answer: Tokal says the Horde did not order the raids on human and dwarven camps. Rumors blame the Horde, but her group worked under a private mercenary contract.
faq.q: Was the Horde responsible for pillaging the human and dwarven camps?

faq.answer: Tokal fears a marshal investigating the pillaging of human and dwarven settlements. She checks that anyone approaching her in Booty Bay was not sent to bring her to justice.
faq.q: Why is Tokal worried about a marshal?

faq.answer: Tavern keepers and barkeepers in Booty Bay sell Cherry Grog. Bringing Tokal a mug meets her demand and prompts her to tell her story.
faq.q: Where do you get Cherry Grog for Tokal?

aliases: why is tokal in booty bay
faq.answer: Booty Bay is a freebooter port beyond the strict jurisdiction of the Alliance and Horde. It gives a mercenary hiding after raids on human and dwarven camps a place to lie low.
faq.q: Why is Tokal staying in Booty Bay?

sections.body: Tokal keeps out of sight in Booty Bay and watches for law enforcement. Recent raids devastated human and dwarven camps, and rumors blame the Horde. When travelers come who clearly do not work for the marshal asking questions, Tokal gives another account. She offers to tell it in exchange for a drink.
sections.title: The Whispers in Booty Bay

sections.body: Tokal admits she joined the pillaging of human and dwarven outposts, but says the Horde did not carry out the raids. Her band worked under a private contract for an unnamed third party. Tokal insists on a Cherry Grog before she names who paid for the operation and why.
sections.title: Private Mercenaries

summary: In Booty Bay, Tokal offers a drink for the truth about attacks on human and dwarven outposts. Rumors blame the Horde, but her band served a private mercenary contract.
attribution: In-game quest text: Cherry for Your Thoughts?
